candidate_relations.label: Bartholin's gland adenocarcinoma

candidate_relations.scope_detail: Adenocarcinoma is a glandular epithelial malignancy; leiomyosarcoma is a mesenchymal smooth muscle malignancy — incompatible histological subtypes at the same anatomical site

candidate_relations.label: Bartholin's gland cyst

candidate_relations.scope_detail: A benign cystic lesion versus a malignant mesenchymal neoplasm; entirely different diagnostic entities
